# Raj Patel — VP Platform

- **Relationship:** Maya's direct report. Owns platform engineering, infrastructure, and SRE
  (~45 people). The technical linchpin of the re-architecture. Joined Novaflow in 2021.
- **Cadence:** weekly 1:1, Wednesdays 9:30; joins the reliability review.
- **Owns:** [Atlas v2 Platform](../projects/atlas-v2-platform.md) (the new internal platform)
  **and** the [Meridian](../projects/meridian.md) reliability/SLA program.
- **Delegates:** the service-mesh GA — the critical path inside Atlas v2 — to staff engineer
  [Grace Liu](grace-liu.md).

## How to work with him
- Deeply technical and honest about risk; if Raj says a date is real, it's real.
- Prone to over-scoping the "right" architecture; Maya keeps him anchored to the migration's needs.
- Give him air cover with the board when he needs to invest in reliability foundations.

## Sensitivities
- Owns the June SLA breach personally and is grinding on Meridian; watch for burnout.
- Under pressure because Atlas Migration cannot finish until his Atlas v2 platform GAs.
